post_primary.label: Post-primary bone tumor care: subtype-specific surveillance and response assessment; route proven recurrence to the recurrence pathway.

recommendation.title: Post-primary bone tumor care: subtype-specific surveillance and response assessment; route proven recurrence to the recurrence pathway.

options.label: Subtype-specific surveillance
options.text: Use imaging/clinical schedule and late-effects monitoring from the relevant source pathway.

options.label: Re-biopsy/re-stage suspected relapse
options.text: Do not assume recurrent disease without source-required confirmation.

phase_unknown.label: Bone tumor care phase is not established.

chon_primary.label: Chondrosarcoma: subtype/grade/location-directed surgical pathway; systemic/RT options vary by histology.

recommendation.title: Chondrosarcoma: subtype/grade/location-directed surgical pathway; systemic/RT options vary by histology.

options.label: Surgery
options.text: Use curettage or wide resection based on grade, compartment, and site.

options.label: Adjunct systemic/RT
options.text: Use only for source-defined histologies/settings.

chon_met.label: Metastatic chondrosarcoma: histology/molecularly directed systemic therapy, local control, or clinical trial.

recommendation.title: Metastatic chondrosarcoma: histology/molecularly directed systemic therapy, local control, or clinical trial.

options.label: Systemic therapy
options.text: Use BONE-B subtype-specific options including targeted therapy when alteration-specific.

options.label: Local therapy
options.text: Surgery/RT/ablation for selected metastatic sites.

chor_primary.label: Chordoma: histologic subtype/site-directed maximal safe resection and high-dose RT strategy.

recommendation.title: Chordoma: histologic subtype/site-directed maximal safe resection and high-dose RT strategy.

options.label: Surgery
options.text: Maximal safe en bloc/complete resection when feasible.

options.label: RT
options.text: Use highly conformal dose-escalated RT in appropriate pre/postoperative or unresectable settings.

chor_rec.label: Chordoma surveillance/recurrence: resect, re-irradiate, ablate or use systemic therapy according to site/prior treatment.

recommendation.title: Chordoma surveillance/recurrence: resect, re-irradiate, ablate or use systemic therapy according to site/prior treatment.

options.label: Local salvage
options.text: Surgery and/or RT/ablative therapy.

options.label: Systemic therapy
options.text: Use BONE-B options for unresectable/progressive disease.

ew_primary.label: Localized Ewing sarcoma: systemic therapy + local control (surgery and/or RT) with restaging and completion therapy.

recommendation.title: Localized Ewing sarcoma: systemic therapy + local control (surgery and/or RT) with restaging and completion therapy.

options.label: Multiagent systemic therapy
options.text: Use source-listed Ewing regimen.

options.label: Local control
options.text: Surgery and/or RT based on anatomy/response/margins.

ew_rel.label: Relapsed/refractory Ewing sarcoma: salvage systemic therapy and site-specific local control/palliation.

recommendation.title: Relapsed/refractory Ewing sarcoma: salvage systemic therapy and site-specific local control/palliation.

options.label: Salvage systemic therapy
options.text: Use source-listed second-line regimens.

options.label: Local control
options.text: RT/surgery/ablation for progressive sites where appropriate.

ew_met.label: Metastatic Ewing sarcoma: systemic therapy with primary/metastatic site local control based on distribution and response.

recommendation.title: Metastatic Ewing sarcoma: systemic therapy with primary/metastatic site local control based on distribution and response.

options.label: Systemic therapy
options.text: Use Ewing multiagent therapy.

options.label: Metastasis-directed therapy
options.text: Consider lung/bone/site-directed RT/surgery in source-defined settings.

gctb_primary.label: Giant cell tumor of bone: resection/curettage when feasible; denosumab, embolization, RT or ablation for selected unresectable/morbid sites.

recommendation.title: Giant cell tumor of bone: resection/curettage when feasible; denosumab, embolization, RT or ablation for selected unresectable/morbid sites.

options.label: Surgery
options.text: Preferred when acceptable morbidity.

options.label: Denosumab/embolization
options.text: Preferred/selected for unresectable or unacceptable morbidity axial lesions.

options.label: RT/ablation
options.text: Selected circumstances.

gctb_rec.label: Recurrent GCTB: repeat local therapy and/or denosumab/embolization/RT based on site and resectability.

recommendation.title: Recurrent GCTB: repeat local therapy and/or denosumab/embolization/RT based on site and resectability.

options.label: Recurrence treatment
options.text: Use source-defined surgery/systemic/local options.

osteo_primary.label: Localized osteosarcoma: neoadjuvant systemic therapy, complete surgical resection, then response-directed adjuvant therapy.

recommendation.title: Localized osteosarcoma: neoadjuvant systemic therapy, complete surgical resection, then response-directed adjuvant therapy.

options.label: Neoadjuvant chemotherapy
options.text: Use source osteosarcoma regimen(s).

options.label: Definitive surgery
options.text: Complete resection with limb-sparing when oncologically feasible.

options.label: Adjuvant therapy
options.text: Continue/adjust per histologic response and source protocol.

osteo_met.label: Metastatic osteosarcoma: systemic therapy plus aggressive local control of primary and resectable metastases when feasible.

recommendation.title: Metastatic osteosarcoma: systemic therapy plus aggressive local control of primary and resectable metastases when feasible.

options.label: Systemic therapy
options.text: Use osteosarcoma systemic regimen.

options.label: Metastasectomy/local therapy
options.text: For resectable pulmonary/other metastatic disease when appropriate.

osteo_rel.label: Relapsed osteosarcoma: complete resection of relapse when feasible plus source-listed systemic/RT/local options.

recommendation.title: Relapsed osteosarcoma: complete resection of relapse when feasible plus source-listed systemic/RT/local options.

options.label: Surgical salvage
options.text: Preferred for resectable recurrence when feasible.

options.label: Systemic/RT
options.text: Use source-listed salvage options for unresectable/progressive disease.

workup.label: Unclassified/suspected primary bone tumor: multidisciplinary orthopedic-oncology workup and biopsy at treating center before subtype-specific treatment.

recommendation.title: Unclassified/suspected primary bone tumor: multidisciplinary orthopedic-oncology workup and biopsy at treating center before subtype-specific treatment.

options.label: Multidisciplinary evaluation
options.text: Orthopedic oncology, pathology, radiology and oncology review.

options.label: Biopsy at treating center
options.text: Plan biopsy with definitive surgery in mind.

outside.label: Case is outside Bone cancer ruleset.
